definition: P*=row q75 of P(H=0.5,tau=0.08/0.10); R is fold-training Zhang non-W/W logistic calibration to 0.05/0.95; f=sigmoid(logit(Fs)+0.25*(2R-1))

base_model.definition: Fs=logistic(fixed self-similarity construction; robust default is the median across the nine predeclared gamma values of a fixed long/short persistence ratio); f=Fs+alpha*Fs*(1-Fs)*(2R-1); primary R is tanh-calibrated return prominence
base_model.selection_rule: phase 1 selects one fixed physical Fs candidate by the mean objective across 3 deterministic participant-grouped CV repeats; phase 2 selects one return-prominence R and alpha on that locked OOF Fs; 0.005*alpha penalizes unnecessary correction; Zhang W-vs-N1 has the largest weight

selected_Fs_metrics_oof.calibration: smooth logistic; N3->0.05, W->0.95; deterministic 3-repeat grouped CV

selected_S_metrics_oof.calibration: smooth logistic; N3->0.05, W->0.95; deterministic 3-repeat grouped CV

selected_dense_repeat_metrics_oof.repeat_calibration: fold-training N3/W tanh to 0.05/0.95; averaged over 3 deterministic grouped-CV repeats

constraints.Fs_family: default: 20 fixed long/short persistence ratios, each marginalized by the median over all nine predeclared gamma values
constraints.return_prominence_direction: higher P must imply higher R and f

label_usage.manual_final_stage: grid selection and fold-local N3/W anchors

selection_rule: P*, q=0.75, logistic direction, and beta=0.25 are fixed design choices; only the underlying robust Fs definition is training-selected by the v2 repeated participant-grouped procedure

constraints.repeat_calibration_scope: Zhang W versus all Zhang non-W
constraints.repeat_physical_direction: higher P* must imply higher R; no sign flip
